$comment: Lists for scripts/check-release-text.mjs. This file is never checked itself, so it may name what it bans. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions, matched case-insensitively. Paths are repository paths; a path ending in / covers the folder. Names (employers, competitors) are not kept here: put them in a private JSON file with the same names/phrases keys, at $SHAPEWALL_RELEASE_NAMES or ~/.config/shapewall-dev/release-names.json, and the gate adds them.

phrases.why: positioning: Shapewall steers and builds with agents, it is not a feedback or review tool

phrases.pattern: tested with automated browsers|not yet verified|is planned|has not launched
phrases.why: a process note, not product copy

dashesAllowed.$comment: Code that has to name the characters themselves: text-to-speech splitting, SEO width tables, an en dash as an empty cell, and tests that assert there is none.

phrasesAllowed.$comment: Tests that check the same phrases themselves. Names are still checked here.
